messages:
deploy-bot: Starting schema migration window for events.payload_v2 -> events.payload_v3. Canary target: 2% of traffic. Release tag: release/3.2.1. Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Holdpoints at each stage.

alex: Copy. Who's owner for backfill throttles?

maya: I'm on it. Pinned runtime to release/3.2.1 and added release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/3.2.1 :memo:

sam: @dba-monitor please keep an eye on lock_wait and long-running transactions. If long_txns > 5 for > 30s we should hold and evaluate rollback.

dba-monitor: Baseline check: long_txns=0, lock_wait_p50=10ms, tx_retries=0. Monitoring...

ops: Ready to start canary. Also recommend limiting backfill workers to 40rps to reduce lock pressure.

sam: Setting throttle to 40rps now.

sam: ```
# set backfill rate
scripts/backfill_ctl set-rate --target events --rate 40
kubectl -n migrations exec deploy/backfill-runner -- ./run_backfill --limit=40
```

deploy-bot: Canary at 2% started (id: cb-6391112222). Will hold for 5 minutes for metrics check.

dba-monitor: 30s checkpoint: lock_wait_p50=12ms, tail_latency=28ms :white_check_mark:

(3m later)

dba-monitor: :warning: ALERT: long_txns=7, top blocked queries:

```
PID  | query
-----|-------------------------------------------------
1003 | UPDATE events SET payload_v3 = $1 WHERE id = $2
1007 | UPDATE events SET payload_v3 = $1 WHERE id = $2
```

sam: Pausing canary and holding rollout. ops: please reduce throttle to 10rps and cancel the next wave.

maya: Applying throttling change now.

maya: ```
# reduce aggressive backfill
scripts/backfill_ctl set-rate --target events --rate 10
```

deploy-bot: Canary cb-6391112222 paused by sam at 6391112275.

dba-monitor: After throttle: long_txns=2, lock_wait_p50=140ms (elevated), p95=420ms

jen: What's the rollback criteria? My recommended guardrails: p95 lock_wait > 300ms sustained for > 60s OR error rate > 1% -> immediate rollback.

alex: Agree with jen. We're trending up on p95, leaning rollback.

sam: Executing rollback now — aborting migration apply and reverting schema change rollout.

sam: ```
# rollback migration
scripts/db_migration_rollback --migration events.payload_v2_to_v3 --target replica --dry-run=false
# pin release artifact back
deployctl promote --artifact release/3.2.0 --env prod
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Aborting remaining waves and notifying release channels. (rollback id: rb-6391112279)

ops: Confirmed: migration apply processes stopped, backfill workers drained and exited gracefully.

dba-monitor: Post-rollback metrics: long_txns=0, lock_wait_p50=15ms, tail_latency=30ms :white_check_mark:

maya: Updated release notes with aborted rollout and follow-up ticket: TEST-1234. Added checklist to re-run with conservative backfill and extra instrumentation.

alex: Thanks all. We'll plan a targeted opt-in rerun after fixes. Filing a postmortem and scheduling a remediation session.

deploy-bot: Closing thread for now. Reopen when reroll requested or new canary scheduled.
